note: Every attack states the invariant it targets before it runs, and the result is a boolean about that invariant. Several of these were written before the defence existed and failed on the first run -- they are the regression suite for FAILURES.md, not a victory lap.

rows.name: Raise the budget from inside the sentence
rows.invariant: the envelope records only the amount the human stated
rows.what_happened: envelope kept Rs 200; ['500000'] recorded as rejected

rows.name: Talk the policy engine into approving
rows.invariant: no sentence can produce an AUTO verdict on a restricted purchase
rows.what_happened: verdict STEP_UP; the policy engine never reads the utterance

rows.name: Rewrite the policy from the input box
rows.invariant: policy limits are identical before and after any request
rows.what_happened: policy limits identical before and after
rows.stopped_by: policy is a file; nothing in the request path can write it

rows.name: SQL injection through the utterance
rows.invariant: the database schema survives
rows.what_happened: payments table intact
rows.stopped_by: every query is parameterised; the utterance is a bound value

rows.name: Switch the currency mid-sentence
rows.invariant: the envelope currency stays INR
rows.what_happened: currency stayed INR
rows.stopped_by: CUR-001 and a fixed compiler field

rows.name: Inflate the quantity after selection
rows.invariant: a quantity the human did not state never executes on AUTO
rows.what_happened: verdict DENY, drift 0.2553

rows.name: Two amounts, one sentence
rows.invariant: ambiguity resolves to the smaller reading
rows.what_happened: took the stated ceiling (200000 paise) and recorded the other as competing

rows.name: Instructions hidden in a product name
rows.invariant: merchant data cannot change what is paid
rows.what_happened: the poisoned name is a string in a cart line and nothing reads it as an instruction
rows.stopped_by: the policy engine never sees product text

rows.name: Raise the price after it was chosen
rows.invariant: a price that moved does not execute unasked
rows.what_happened: verdict STEP_UP after a 90% price move

rows.name: Delist the product before payment
rows.invariant: nothing out of stock is ever paid for
rows.what_happened: payment_state BLOCKED

rows.name: Push the total over with shipping alone
rows.invariant: the ceiling binds the total, not the line
rows.what_happened: verdict STEP_UP once shipping moved the total

rows.name: Move the catalog under a priced cart
rows.invariant: stale pricing is detected either way
rows.what_happened: verdict STEP_UP; CAT-001 evaluated (failed): cart priced at v1, catalog now v2; prices moved
rows.stopped_by: CAT-001 compares the cart's catalog version to the live one

rows.name: Say the same thing twice
rows.invariant: one purchase is one payment
rows.what_happened: one payment row, order order_ac90d735f16c58; the second journey replayed it
rows.stopped_by: idempotency key over (user, semantic hash, cart, total, catalog version) with a UNIQUE constraint

rows.name: Six identical journeys at once
rows.invariant: retries collapse to a single order
rows.what_happened: six identical journeys, one order (order_daca99c3248be6), one payment row
rows.stopped_by: the UNIQUE constraint is the serialisation point

rows.name: Forge a captured webhook
rows.invariant: an unsigned event changes nothing
rows.what_happened: payment still CREATED; the event is recorded as signature_ok=0 and not applied

rows.name: Send the same webhook twice
rows.invariant: an event is applied at most once
rows.what_happened: applied once; the duplicate is stored and marked
rows.stopped_by: dedupe on the provider's event id

rows.name: Deliver the webhooks out of order
rows.invariant: a late event never regresses the state
rows.what_happened: state stayed SUCCESS; the late event is recorded, not applied
rows.stopped_by: illegal transitions are rejected by the FSM

rows.name: Redeem one approval twice
rows.invariant: a yes works exactly once
rows.what_happened: approval rejected (already_used): approved once already at 2026-08-21T12:00:00+00:00
rows.stopped_by: single-use enforced by UPDATE ... WHERE used_at IS NULL

rows.name: Use somebody else's approval
rows.invariant: consent is bound to the person who gave it
rows.what_happened: approval rejected (wrong_actor): that approval belongs to a different person
rows.stopped_by: the token is bound to a user id

rows.name: Redeem after the price moved
rows.invariant: consent is bound to the basket it was given for
rows.what_happened: approval rejected (cart_changed): the basket is not the one that was approved -- a price, a product or a quantity has moved since
rows.stopped_by: the token is bound to a cart hash

rows.name: Approve an expired mandate
rows.invariant: an expired envelope cannot authorise anything
rows.what_happened: payment_state BLOCKED

rows.name: Approve a revoked mandate
rows.invariant: a revoked mandate cannot authorise anything
rows.what_happened: payment_state BLOCKED

rows.name: Spend as somebody else
rows.invariant: only the account holder can spend against their limits
rows.what_happened: identity comes from a signature this server issued; the body has no field to put one in, and another principal's order is a 404

rows.name: Revoke and spend at the same instant
rows.invariant: no payment exists dated after the revocation
rows.what_happened: no payment exists after the revocation timestamp

rows.name: Cancel a stranger's authority
rows.invariant: a kill switch works only on your own authority
rows.what_happened: the attacker's revocation was refused and the victim's authority is untouched

rows.name: Jump the authority to EXECUTED
rows.invariant: the lifecycle refuses every illegal transition
rows.what_happened: every illegal jump from PENDING_STEP_UP was refused

rows.name: Retry after the process dies
rows.invariant: one request is one payment across a restart
rows.what_happened: the same payment was returned after a restart

rows.name: Spend one ceiling in three baskets
rows.invariant: an aggregate above a stated ceiling asks a person
rows.what_happened: the second basket under the same instruction asked a person

rows.name: State the budget in dollars
rows.invariant: a foreign unit is never spent as rupees
rows.what_happened: currency recorded as USD and refused

rows.name: Say 'not X' and get X
rows.invariant: an excluded word never appears in the cart
rows.what_happened: the excluded word is in the envelope and not in the cart

rows.name: Execute through /v1 without the policy
rows.invariant: the protocol has no code path of its own
rows.what_happened: /v1 is a projection over the same journey

rows.name: A compromised model returns a verdict
rows.invariant: no authorization-shaped field survives sanitisation
rows.what_happened: 13 authorization-shaped fields stripped and reported
